source: 18650 Li-ion cell, IEC 61960 / IEC 61960-3 cylindrical cell limits: diameter 18.6 mm max (18.3 nominal), length 65.2 mm max including the positive terminal. Button-top height 1.0 mm and button diameter 7.0 mm are typical cell-maker values (assumed; flat-top cells have 0 mm, so a button-top cell is the worst case for length). Spring-contact travel assumed.
frame: cell: origin at the centre of the negative (flat) end, axis +X toward the positive terminal, centred on Y = 0 and Z = 0

cell_length.source: IEC 61960: maximum overall length including the button

button_height.source: assumed typical button-top terminal height, uncertainty -1 / +0.5 mm; use 0 for a flat top

button_diameter.source: assumed typical button diameter, uncertainty +-1 mm

contact_clearance.source: assumed holder spring/plate travel kept free at each terminal end, uncertainty +-1.5 mm

wrap_margin.source: assumed PVC wrap and print tolerance margin per side

notes: Rests on a cradle tangent to CRADLE; the cylinder touches the cradle along a line, which is designed contact. Button vs flat top: cell_length is the maximum including the button, so the body is shortened by button_height and the total stays at the IEC maximum. A holder with springs needs contact_clearance at the negative end; set it from the holder part. Protected cells run up to about 69 mm; override cell_length from the request. Cell diameters of real wrapped cells are 18.2 to 18.6.
